title: The handheld is dead
intro: Wireless mics have two halves: the transmitter (the mic) and the receiver (by the stagebox). Check both.

complaints.says: My handheld mic isn't working at all.

hints: Look at the handheld receiver's RF bars. Is the transmitter on the air at all?
cause: The handheld mic's battery was dead, so it wasn't transmitting. The receiver showed no RF.
lesson: No RF on the receiver means the transmitter isn't on: battery, power switch, or the wrong frequency. Put fresh batteries in wireless mics before every service.
